title: First Letter
description:
So, ready to write your first letter, my dear? Alright, then let's gather up some paper, some ink, and a feather.
Letters are written much like book and quills, their only real limitation being their length, but that's to be expected, isn't it? Well, once your written it and folded it, you'll need two other items, a [seal](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/seal.png) and an [address tag](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/address_tag.png). Use the address tag and write the address you want to send it to, or another's name if they have a default mailbox set up. Next it's a simple matter of right clicking the letter with both the tag and seal to label it properly, and all you have to do is put the letter in your own mailbox, add in a bit of seeds for the pigeon, and wait as a nearby pigeon comes to pick it up, deliver it, and then return. Little fella's going to be worn out afterwards, so don't get too letter happy yet.
